blocks.finding: Both southeast positions are clear wave-textured sea, separated from the west-frame cloud patch.

All three marked groups lie on visible water: the northern/western sequence is water north of a small bright reef/structure, central strip and southeast arc are open sea. Extra unmarked RGB confirms the bright emerged-looking feature is south of the requested centres, so no terrestrial answer is inherited from it.
Four northeast-edge positions are within valid pixels and clear wave-textured sea; scattered western clouds do not obscure them.
All 21 northwest-frame arc positions are clear sea with repeated wave texture and dark NIR; no local cloud or terrestrial body at a centre.
